0022600118.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (2-0, 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West) visit the Sacramento Kings (0-2, 4th in the Pacific and 14th in the West), with Memphis on a two-game winning streak. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Grizzlies won their 2025-26 season series 3-1, though they lost the last meeting 123-114 in Memphis on February 23, 2026. Zach Edey (out, ankle) and Cedric Coward (day-to-day, wrist sprain, game-time decision) are unavailable or uncertain for Memphis, while Sacramento will be without Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (out, calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee), with Keegan Murray (day-to-day, ankle, game-time decision) also in doubt.
